title: Turnip: modeled ₹312/qtl left, Kangra (Baijnath) → Kullu
summary: January 2023: reported turnip prices at Kangra (Baijnath) and Kullu imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 83% of 23 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹312 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 30 same-variety market pairs screened for turnip in January 2023; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kullu report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2023
scenes.caption: Kangra (Baijnath) (Himachal Pradesh) and Kullu (Himachal Pradesh) both reported turnip prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 23 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kangra (Baijnath) reported a median ₹1,325 per quintal. Kullu reported a median ₹1,800 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹450/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹450 per quintal, and Kullu was dearer on 96% of days.

scenes.headline: 187 km by road
scenes.caption: 187 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~4 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹40/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹229 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹123 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kullu report, the rule selects 19 of 23 modeled shipping days. 18 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹312 per quintal (₹211 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Turnip route from Kangra (Baijnath) to Kullu was positive on 83% of matched days in January 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹31,200, or ₹21,100 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to turnip
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹40/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Turnip route from Kangra (Baijnath) to Kullu was positive on 83% of matched days in January 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹31,200, or ₹21,100 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
